rec.name: Collection Page Product Image Slider (Card Carousel)
rec.status: Built — A/B test set up in Ablyft (Mar 2025); result not documented

what.text: A swipeable or arrow-driven image slider inside each product card on the collection page. Shoppers can flip through several images of a product without opening the product page. The control variant shows a single static image per card. The design was reworked to match a customer-approved Figma mockup, which I could not see.

why.text: Shoppers see several views of a product (angles, details, context) right in the grid. This gives a faster, more intuitive preview and reduces the effort of evaluating items. It lowers the need to click through to the PDP just to see more, and it encourages interaction with the product cards. The ticket's hypothesis is that this raises engagement and conversion rate, and keeps users on the page longer. The extra-views-without-leaving-the-page mechanic is the ticket's own reasoning, and the psychology behind it (lower friction, more information before commitment) is my inference.

how.text: Built with a Sectionfy.io section ("CRO | CP | Product Slider") and installed in a dedicated A/B test theme copy, then moved into the main theme once approved. The A/B test was set up in Ablyft with the control (no slider) against the variant (slider). Known pitfalls from the comments: (1) the slider did not initialise properly in the test theme and needed a fix; (2) on first page load the images rendered incorrectly until a manual reload, which was later fixed, so test first-load rendering in QA; (3) the theme contained an Ablyft script, so confirm the correct Ablyft customer account before launch. Styling was adjusted after customer feedback to match a Figma mockup. Check the key metrics are tracking correctly in the first days of the test.

items: Slider on/off (A/B variant toggle via Ablyft)
Number of images per product card (not specified in the ticket)
Navigation style: arrows / dots / swipe (not specified in the ticket)
Visual styling per Figma mockup (details not available)

dependencies.text: Sectionfy.io section 'CRO | CP | Product Slider'. An Ablyft account and experiment for A/B testing. A separate test theme ('A/B Test (PSY)') with the Ablyft script. Products need multiple images in Shopify. Mobile and desktop slider behaviour was not detailed.

items: Collection page to PDP click-through rate
Add-to-cart rate from the collection page
Page speed (LCP) impact from extra images
